lesson.text: Quick memory: where do toys go when you've finished? (Back in their home.) Today: helping at home.
The washing: whites with whites, colours with colours. Socks go in pairs. Fold a T-shirt: one sleeve in, the other, then in half.
Everything has a home: put things back, and they're easy to find.
A plant needs water when its soil feels dry. A pet needs food, fresh water, walks, a clean bed, and a vet when poorly.
Recycling: paper in the paper bin, plastic bottles and cans in theirs. With a grown-up, test the smoke alarm once a month.
Try it in the world: open the practice house. Next: recycling, pets and the table, on the Middle track.
